the-head-of-the-house-of-coombe: Frances Hodgson Burnett, beloved author of The Secret Garden, turns to adult drama in this novel of English high society. The Head of the House of Coombe follows aristocratic lives shadowed by the coming of the Great War, with Burnett's gift for sympathetic heroines. A prequel to her novel Robin, it shows the famous children's author in a more worldly mode.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-abbe: This 1913 Catholic Encyclopedia article on abbé — the French title for clerics, from simple priests to courtly commendatory abbots — explains its history. John Joseph A'Becket traces the term's curious career. An informative reference on old-regime France. From village curés to Versailles wits, the title covered them all.
